sources.quote: In 1748, he published An Enquiry concerning Human Understanding
In 1748, he published An Enquiry concerning Human Understanding
although it initially appeared under the title Philosophical Essays concerning Human Understanding—it would be renamed in a later edition of 1758

notes: year_note: in lần đầu năm 1748 với tên Philosophical Essays concerning Human Understanding; mang tên hiện nay từ bản 1758.
